# BAAH PLATINUM™ — Brands Ambassador Africa Impact Honors

> BAAH PLATINUM™ recognizes Africa's Top 100 brand ambassadors turning brand influence into economic growth and social impact.

This official communiqué announces the honorees, explains the selection approach, and lists the Top 100 African brand ambassadors grouped by region.
